websites.name: Magic UI

websites.name: Three.js

websites.name: Shadertoy
websites.caution: Individual shaders have creator-specific rights, potentially non-commercial, and may not be production-performant.

websites.name: Lovable
websites.caution: A hosted creation service is not a drop-in code dependency. Review plans, generated code, data access and export terms.

websites.name: Skill Issue
bestFor: Finding task-specific skills for coding agents across software projects
Curating reusable agent workflows for design, web, mobile and game development
Comparing upstream skill sources before human-reviewed installation
websites.caution: A directory listing is not proof that any linked SKILL.md, installer, prompt, source or license is safe. Review original repository, pinned revision, permissions, instructions and compatibility before using; never auto-run remote install commands.

websites.name: Game Art Style
bestFor: Comparing original game visual styles across pixel art, illustration and 3D
Defining consistent art direction for characters, environments, UI, effects and animation
Finding real-game visual references and art-direction prompt examples
websites.caution: Screenshots and reference images belong to their respective owners; this gallery does not license artwork for copying or redistribution. Use it to guide original art direction, and check rights before reusing any media.

websites.name: Jupiter the Warlock — Game Art Style
bestFor: Evaluating visual art-direction references for game projects
Finding inspiration for original characters, environments and effects
websites.caution: The linked page could not be independently fetched at admission time. Treat it as an unverified visual reference, not a licensed source of images, code or game assets. Review live availability and each creator's usage rights before using any content.

websites.name: Viggle PINOC MCP
bestFor: Finding and importing free preset 3D motion clips into compatible games and animation tools
Agent-assisted motion capture from video and text-to-motion character animation
Connecting reviewed MCP clients to rigged character and motion assets for Blender, Unity, Unreal and web 3D
websites.caution: PINOC MCP requires interactive user login and authorization. Connect read-only first. Preset motion browsing and retrieval are free; generating characters or motion consumes credits (text/video motion 1 credit per second, character 6–10 credits). Never grant write/generate scopes or spend credits automatically; verify asset licenses, privacy and engine/rig compatibility.

websites.name: Rosebud AI
bestFor: Exploring game mechanics and rapid visual iterations
websites.caution: Free game creation does not establish commercial-use rights: check plans and export terms. A hosted game generator is not a drop-in engine library; do not upload private code or auto-publish.

websites.name: Convai
bestFor: Reviewing Unity, Unreal or web character SDK integrations
websites.caution: Requires a hosted account and API configuration. Check engine compatibility, latency, privacy, commercial plans and SDK terms; do not grant keys or capture player audio automatically.

websites.name: Inworld AI
bestFor: Evaluating real-time speech and game dialogue APIs
Comparing voice infrastructure for interactive characters
websites.caution: Current offerings emphasize low-latency speech and inference, not necessarily legacy NPC integrations. Verify supported engines, pricing, privacy and API terms before use.

websites.name: Ludo.ai
bestFor: Brainstorming gameplay mechanics and retention loops
Drafting game design documents and art direction
Reviewing optional asset generation through CLI, MCP or API
websites.caution: Hosted and credit-based: generation, CLI, REST API and MCP may require an account or consume credits. Check export/commercial rights; never install agents or spend credits automatically.

websites.name: Sloyd AI
bestFor: Exploring generated game-ready 3D meshes and props
Reviewing topology, textures and polygon counts before asset import
websites.caution: Generated assets are not automatically licensed or optimized for production. Check export formats, commercial terms, rig suitability and performance before importing into a game.

websites.name: Charisma AI
bestFor: Designing branching interactive dialogue and plot triggers
Reviewing character-driven narrative SDKs for Unity or Unreal
websites.caution: Creation may require an account, trial licence or commercial agreement. SDKs and narrative workflows are not compatible with every engine; check pricing, privacy and rights.

websites.name: modl.ai
bestFor: Planning automated gameplay, exploratory and regression tests
Evaluating AI agents that report crashes, softlocks and visual bugs
websites.caution: Provider currently advertises build-upload testing without SDK integration; older docs describe Unity plugins. Check current platform support, costs, build privacy and test reproducibility before uploading.
